title: Get improved search reliability with circuit breakers
description: Jira Service Management now includes circuit breakers for alert and incident search to improve service reliability during high-traffic periods. When the search cluster is unhealthy, affected search requests will fail fast with a service unavailable message instead of causing the entire app to slow down.
